0x000838.en: 「As I am now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000931.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A5A.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!?」

0x000B96.en: 「Like hell I'll screw up here...!@　Not funny...」

0x000BEA.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000C5E.en: 「Gah! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D3B.en: 「This is it... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DE7.en: 「No good, I took too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000E34.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E72.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EB9.en: 「The Granzon... shot down, of all things...」

0x000F64.en: 「Ugh... So I became a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x000FE3.en: 「T-this is as far as I can go...!」

0x001154.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001189.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x001275.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x0012C3.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x00137E.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x0013AD.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013EB.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00141A.en: 「I can't go on. If you'll excuse me.」

0x0014A5.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0019AA.en: 「Leave this to me and my Type-Zero. The rest of you, fall back!」

0x001A2A.en: 「Same here!@ We have to buy time for the director and the others to evacuate!」

0x001ACA.en: 「...Understood. But don't push yourselves too hard.」

0x001C17.en: 「That is... both a living thing and a machine...」

0x001C5A.en: 「A machine...? It sure doesn't look like one!」

0x001C97.en: 「There's no pilot aboard...@ Instead, I think something like a soul is sealed inside.」

0x001D0E.en: 「I have my suspicions.@ They're most likely Yokijin...@ the enemies of the <Chokijin>.」

0x001D8E.en: 「During the <Shura War>, a different type from those@ appeared here as well.」

0x001DEC.en: 「Then are they after the RyuOhKi and KoOhKi@ in the underground cages!?」

0x001E4E.en: 「No mistake about it.@ But Bullet and Kusuha aren't here now...@ We'll have to protect the Chokijin ourselves.」

0x001EE7.en: 「Don't let those Yokijin near the institute!」

0x001F40.en: Tesla Leicht Institute Underground - Chokijin Cage

0x001FAA.en: 「Dr. Anzai, it's dangerous here! Evacuate, quickly!」

0x001FF0.en: 「But the RyuOhKi and KoOhKi@ are about to awaken!」

0x002062.en: 「They're clearly reacting to the Yokijin,@ but it's different from last time!」

0x0020E5.en: 「But Bullet and Kusuha aren't here now...@ We can't control them!」

0x002184.en: 「The others are fighting hard up top!@ If we don't evacuate, it'll all be for nothing!」

0x00222C.en: 「Raul, an object is approaching us at high speed!」

0x0022C4.en: 「From the look of it, it's a different type.@ But it's not a <PT>, <AM>, or <Super Robot>...」

0x002347.en: 「...Seiryu and Byakko still won't wake.@ Just as Yomogi said, either there's no Kyounensha,@ or else...」

0x0023F0.en: 「My name is Kukuru.@ I've come to reclaim the Seiryu and Byakko Chokijin@ that you've been sheltering.」

0x0024B8.en: 「The Chokijin are not yours.@ They belong rightfully with us.」

0x002570.en: 「...Kukuru, was it? Listen well.@ The RyuOhKi and KoOhKi fought the enemies of@ the human world alongside my disciples...」

0x002600.en: 「If you were the same, you'd have no need@ to come reclaim those two@ through methods like this.」

0x0026A6.en: 「In other words, you're enemies of humanity.@ Am I wrong?」

0x002749.en: 「Had you obeyed meekly, I'd have let you@ savor life a while longer...」

0x0027C9.en: 「In the end, you're wretches gasping at the bottom of a bitter sea!@ You could never grasp my master's will!」

0x002843.en: 「Then, my Magalga's dance shall send you to the netherworld...」

0x0028C8.en: 「My name is Rishu! Rishu Togo!@ I am the blade that severs evil!!」

0x002930.en: 「My Type-Zero will guide you down the road to Yomi!!」

0x002970.en: 「Bah, old fool!@ Scatter what little life you have left, right here!!」

0x0029D5.en: 「Ngh, for the Magalga to be outmatched!」

0x002B91.en: (But that last strike... could it be)

0x002CCB.en: 「Now, JakuOhKi... let's take your comrades home.」

0x002D27.en: Damage dealt to target: value that leaves RyuOhKi at about 1000 HP

0x002E11.en: Damage dealt to target: value that leaves RyuOhKi at about 20 HP

0x002F21.en: 「...Careless of me.@ I didn't think it was so fragile.」

0x002FA8.en: 「Yeah... I wanted to test how the JakuOhKi turned out,@ and I wasn't confident with just you.」

0x003022.en: 「Breaking the RyuOhKi was my blunder.@ Well, that just shows how superior the JakuOhKi's power is.」

0x0030B7.en: 「A shame we can't gather all four gods...@ but even half of a pair has its uses.@ JakuOhKi, capture the KoOhKi.」

0x003206.en: 「...The enemy signals are gone...!@　Let's rescue Professor Rishu and@　put out the fires at the Tesla Institute.」

0x003290.en: 「That's... what we have to do right now...!」

0x0032E3.en: 「You think you can drag me down to the underworld? Laughable!@　I'll send you there instead!」

0x003348.en: 「My years may be few, but even so,@　I still have things left undone in this world...」

0x0033A7.en: 「I won't be dragged down with the likes of you!」

0x0033E1.en: 「You said 'my master'! Who is that!?@　And what do you mean to do with the Chokijin!!?」

0x003467.en: 「You have no need to know that!」

0x003510.en: 「He's still unconscious...@　but the doctor says his life isn't in danger.」

0x0035B8.en: 「Yes. He'll need rest for a while, but...@　the Professor trains his body like no ordinary man.@　He'll surely pull through.」

0x00364B.en: 「I'm sorry...@　If we'd done our jobs better,@　none of this would've happened...」

0x0036C0.en: 「There was nothing you could do in that situation...@　And it's because you were there@　that the damage didn't spread further.」

0x00374D.en: 「But the KoOhKi was taken, and the RyuOhKi...」

0x0037C9.en: 「Despinis is right.@　It wasn't completely destroyed.」

0x00383E.en: 「Yeah. The RyuOhKi's main engine...@ the Gogyoki, is still alive.」

0x0038A0.en: 「But its wings, both legs, and tail@　are gone. It has a self-repair ability,@　but in that state...」

0x003952.en: 「You mean to use parts from the Grungust series?」

0x003998.en: 「As expected of the director. You catch on quick.」

0x0039C9.en: 「But this isn't like when it took in the Grungust Type-3.@ That time, they did it of their own will.@ This time...」

0x003A68.en: 「That's the gamble.@ With no interpreter like Kusuha around, I know it's@ dangerous to put a scalpel to the RyuOhKi, but...」

0x003B1F.en: 「At this rate, it'll only die.@　If we clear the path far enough,@　it may manage the fusion on its own after that.」

0x003BC1.en: 「And I don't think the RyuOhKi itself@ intends to end here, either...」

0x003C29.en: 「But don't you have business in Orleans?」

0x003C75.en: 「I'm only there to observe, and Kirk's there too,@　so a five-day trip should cover it.」

0x003D26.en: 「Thank you. I'll use the spare parts from the Type-2@　and Type-1 we stripped down for maintenance.」

0x003D9A.en: 「And Dr. Anzai, Dr. Nate...@　you've both continued the <Chokijin> research,@　so I'd like your cooperation as well.」

0x003E76.en: 「...Raul, Fiona.@　I'd like the two of you to stay at the Tesla@　Institute for a while. Would that be all right?」

0x003F12.en: 「To handle repairs and guard duty both?」

0x003F4F.en: 「Yes.@　We'd predicted the Yokijin would strike here@　again someday, but...」

0x003FBB.en: 「With Bullet, Kusuha, and the Steel Dragon Squadron@ all missing, we'll of course keep asking the@ Federation for guard duty too.」

0x0040B8.en: 「...Until now the Yokijin haven't shown any@　organized movement, but here at last@　we've caught a glimpse of what's behind them.」

0x004166.en: 「It's possible that bird-type unit wasn't a Yokijin@　but a Chokijin... and one of the Four Gods, at that...?」

0x004231.en: 「Guardians of the four directions: Seiryu@ east, Byakko west, Suzaku south,@ Genbu north - often bird and turtle.」

0x0042E5.en: 「And the RyuOhKi is Seiryu's, the KoOhKi@ Byakko's Chokijin... that bird may be@ Suzaku's Chokijin...」

0x004368.en: 「If so... why attack the RyuOhKi and KoOhKi,@ Chokijin of the same Four Gods? Isn't their enemy@ the Yokijin? And that woman, Kukuru...?」

0x004474.en: 「Tell us.@　You understand as well as anyone that@　we need every scrap of information right now.」

0x004517.en: 「...All right.@　If they truly exist and have begun to move...@　there's no point keeping it secret.」

0x0045B6.en: 「The LTR Organization I belong to holds@　a top-secret document, never disclosed outside,@　called the Order File...」

0x00464F.en: 「It records an organization that worked in the shadows@　using Chokijin and Yokijin around the time of the@　World War in the Old Calendar era.」
